name: gepard-ext-gdscript
description: Bundled GDScript language extension for Gepard (headless Godot editor language server).

scripts.build: esbuild index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=es2023 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js --log-level=warning
